label: Gala — Otacon

sprite.name: OTACON — MGS1
sprite.incarnation: Hal Otacon Emmerich of original MGS1, same thin young civilian body, worried expressive face, messy medium brown/gray-shaded hair and thin round metal glasses. Original scientist evening tuxedo: slim midnight navy dinner jacket with black satin shawl lapels, pale cool-gray waistcoat, white collared shirt, small dark-blue bow tie, sky-blue pocket square, fitted midnight trousers, understated black formal shoes. Small rectangular science ID in breast pocket, no laboratory coat or hoodie. Bare hands; no gun, weapon, armor, muscular soldier body or invented equipment. Preserve his hesitant stance and all exact civilian gestures.
